situation: 秘密の計画が敵にバレそうになっている。情報を隠さなければ！
english: A secret plan is about to be exposed to the enemy. We must hide the information!
hint: put a door on your mouth
explanation: 口に戸を立てる (kuchi ni to wo tateru) = 秘密を守る、口外しないようにする
englishExplanation: to keep a secret, to not let something slip out

situation: 仲間が危険な罠にかかってしまった。すぐに助け出さないと！
english: A companion got caught in a dangerous trap. We have to rescue them right away!
explanation: 手を引く (te wo hiku) = 援助する、助け出す
englishExplanation: to lend assistance, to pull someone out of trouble

situation: 敵が大勢押し寄せてきた。全員で力を合わせて戦うしかない！
english: A horde of enemies is closing in. We have no choice but to fight together!
explanation: 肩を並べる (kata wo naraberu) = 協力する、共に戦う
englishExplanation: to cooperate, to fight side by side

situation: ボスが弱点を見せた。今がチャンス、一気に決着をつけよう！
english: The boss just showed a weakness. This is our chance — let's finish it!
explanation: けりをつける (keri wo tsukeru) = 決着をつける、終わりにする
englishExplanation: to settle things, to bring something to an end

situation: 謎の商人が怪しい取引を持ちかけてきた。騙されないように注意しよう！
english: A mysterious merchant is proposing a shady deal. Be careful not to get fooled!
explanation: 足元を見る (ashimoto wo miru) = 相手の弱みにつけこむ（警戒が必要）
englishExplanation: to take advantage of someone's weakness (stay on guard)
